resources.string: Subtitles and spoken translation on top of any app
Free and private: speech recognition and translation run on the phone. Basic translation quality.
Better translations from Google Gemini that use the previous sentences as context. Speech is recognised on the phone; only the caption text is sent to Google. Needs internet.

Real-time voice translation by Gemini Live Translate: it listens to the audio itself, detects the spoken language, and speaks the translation in a natural voice. The audio is sent to Google. Needs internet.
Create a free key at aistudio.google.com/apikey. Free keys have per-minute and per-day limits.
Detected automatically by Gemini Live (70+ languages, including Khmer).

Works without internet after a one-time 910 MB download (use Wi-Fi). Slower and less accurate than Gemini: the Khmer line appears a few seconds after each sentence ends. Needs a phone with about 6 GB of RAM or more.
Translates whatever is playing on the phone. Some apps (calls, certain streaming and music apps) block audio capture — use Microphone for those.
Translates speech around you, for example the person you are talking to. Wear headphones to hear the translation privately.
Speak the translation in my headphones
You hear Gemini\'s translated voice almost in real time. Tap the speaker button on the captions to mute it.
Your phone\'s text-to-speech voice reads each translated sentence. For a natural real-time voice, choose Gemini Live.
Choose a language to translate into first.
The %1$s voice is not downloaded yet.
This phone has no %1$s voice. Speech Services by Google provides one for free.
Open Settings › Accessibility › Text-to-speech to install a voice.
Lower other audio while the translation speaks
Use the phone speaker when no headphones are connected
For example: football match, cooking show, physics lecture. Helps Gemini get names and terms right.
Changes apply to running captions right away. While captions run, tap them for quick controls.
Each sentence starts on its own line, and the newest one is always shown whole at the bottom. Earlier sentences stay above it while they fit. Turn off for one running line of text.
Show Gemini Live\'s text as its voice speaks it
Ready. Models download on first use; the Offline engine then works without internet.
Captions are running. Switch to any app.
Couldn\'t load the speaker model, so speakers aren\'t told apart this time.
Audio recording permission is required to transcribe speech.
Allow \"Display over other apps\" so captions can float on top, then tap Start again.
Enter your Gemini API key to use Gemini.
Choose a language for Gemini Live to translate into.
This engine can\'t translate into the selected language. Pick another language or engine.
Could not open the audio source.
Gemini\'s rate limit was reached. Translation pauses briefly, then catches up.
Download the %1$s voice in Live Caption\'s settings to hear translations.
This phone has no %1$s voice, so translations are shown but not spoken.
Connect headphones to hear the translation.
Show or hide the original text
Lock subtitles so touches reach the app underneath
Listening… Tap the subtitles for controls.
Paused. Tap the subtitles, then ▶ to resume.
Locked: touches now reach the app underneath. Unlock from the notification or by opening Live Caption.
Live subtitles. Tap for controls, drag to move.
Subtitles are locked. Tap Unlock to use their controls again.
Marks each sentence 👨 man, 👩 woman or 🧒 child, and gives each speaker their own colour. It is guessed from the voice, so it can be wrong, for example over loud music or with very high or low voices.
Offline and Gemini engines. Downloads a 13 MB voice model once. With Gemini Live you get man / woman / child, without numbers.
The phone voice speaks lower for men and higher for women and children. Gemini Live imitates each speaker\'s voice by itself.
Save a transcript of each session
Kept only on this phone. Open a transcript to read it, get a summary from Gemini, share it, or save it as a text or subtitle (.srt) file.
Transcripts are turned off. Turn on \"Save a transcript\" in settings.
No transcripts yet.\nThey are saved while captions run.
Summaries are written by Gemini. Add your Gemini API key in Live Caption\'s settings.
Get a title, a short overview and the key points of what was said.
Gemini\'s rate limit was reached. Try again in %1$d s.
This can\'t be undone. A transcript being recorded right now is kept.
